pkgmetadata.longdescription: OpenCode Swarm is an architect-centric agentic swarm plugin for OpenCode: hub-and-spoke orchestration with SME consultation, code generation, critic and review gates, and QA-driven phase closures. Designed for sessions where the model claiming "done" must be backed by passing tests, lint, and adversarial review before code ships.

use.flag: Enable execution isolation and filesystem sandboxing via sys-apps/bubblewrap
